_comment: Declared LEGACY parity video source for the proof gallery (J-0c T-06). The proof gallery generator has no manifest path for a non-AlpenFlight (legacy flsweb) video — the Playwright JSON report only carries AlpenFlight real-idp proofs. This sidecar declares the legacy parity video(s) keyed to a journey, captioned, so the generator can render them in the SAME journey section, clearly labelled as the legacy side (legacy-vs-AlpenFlight, side by side). `file` is resolved relative to THIS sidecar's directory; the .webm must exist on disk (same AC5 link-check as AlpenFlight proofs). In CI the workflow stages the legacy .webm here and writes this sidecar before running the generator with --legacy-video <dir>.

videos.caption: Legacy flsweb: a random-named Location is created and set as homebase on 2 clubs — the global Location row the migration fans out into 2 distinct per-club AlpenFlight rows
